findings.evidence: 'Shape changes happen in place, in this order: (1) deploy readers that accept both shapes everywhere; ... (5) only then tighten the validator with `collMod`.' This five-step procedure sits inside a Gotchas bullet, and workflow step 1 sends the agent there for it.
findings.fix: Move the five-step MongoDB shape-change sequence into its own workflow sub-step or a short '### MongoDB shape change' block under Workflow. Keep the gotcha to the trap itself (no FKs, validators do not re-check old documents) and point it at the procedure. Delete nothing.

findings.evidence: 'PostgreSQL 18+ can skip the CHECK: `ADD CONSTRAINT users_phone_nn NOT NULL phone NOT VALID;`'. This minimum-version fact has no source URL and no date checked, while every other version fact in the file has both.
findings.fix: Add the official source and a check date, for example '(https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.0/, checked <date>)', or tell the agent to confirm the form on the target server's ALTER TABLE page before using it.
